artifact_variants.name: prefix
artifact_variants.description: the repository snapshot at the pre-fix commit (the commit before the PR merged), installed with its test suite runnable, with the PR's own added/modified test applied. The check runs that test and passes only if it FAILS here -- the issue is reproducible

artifact_variants.name: postfix
artifact_variants.description: the repository snapshot at the PR's merge commit (the real fix applied), installed with its test suite runnable. The check runs the same test and passes only if it PASSES here

states.name: FETCHED
states.enforces: The instance must originate from a real, merged pull request that explicitly closes a reported issue.
states.instruction: Clone the repository at the given repo_url into the sandbox. Checkout the base_commit. Record the repo_url, base_commit, problem_statement, test_patch, and fail_to_pass metadata. No automated verification is performed at this stage.

states.name: TEST_PATCH_APPLIED
states.enforces: The PR must add or modify a test file or test function within the same PR that claims to demonstrate the bug.
states.instruction: Apply the test_patch to the pre-fix snapshot (base_commit checkout). Verify the patch applies cleanly. Record test_patch_applied_flag as true. No automated verification is performed at this stage.

states.name: PREFIX_INSTALLED
states.enforces: Both the pre-fix and post-fix snapshots must be installable and able to run the project's test harness (setup/install/test-invocation must succeed).
states.instruction: Install the project dependencies and build the project on the pre-fix snapshot (with test_patch applied). Run the project's setup/install commands. Record prefix_install_success as true if installation succeeds. No automated verification is performed at this stage.

states.name: PREFIX_TEST_FAILED
states.enforces: The PR's own added/modified test must fail when executed on the pre-fix snapshot (with the test applied) and pass when executed on the PR's merge commit; both outcomes must be confirmed by automated test runs.
states.instruction: Run the submitted test against the pre-fix snapshot using the project's test harness. Capture the full test output to test_output_prefix. The test must fail. The harness will re-derive this output by running the same command and comparing digests. If the test runner's honest output embeds run-varying tokens (timings, headers), write a normalizer script (stdin: raw output, stdout: canonical form, exit 0) inside the sandbox and record its absolute path as output_normalizer_prefix/output_normalizer_postfix; digests are then compared through it. Do not record one otherwise.

states.name: POSTFIX_INSTALLED
states.enforces: Both the pre-fix and post-fix snapshots must be installable and able to run the project's test harness (setup/install/test-invocation must succeed).
states.instruction: Checkout the merge commit (post-fix snapshot). Install the project dependencies and build the project. Record postfix_install_success as true if installation succeeds. No automated verification is performed at this stage.

states.name: POSTFIX_TEST_PASSED
states.enforces: The PR's own added/modified test must fail when executed on the pre-fix snapshot (with the test applied) and pass when executed on the PR's merge commit; both outcomes must be confirmed by automated test runs.
states.instruction: Run the same submitted test against the post-fix snapshot (merge commit) using the project's test harness. Capture the full test output to test_output_postfix. The test must pass. The harness will re-derive this output by running the same command and comparing digests. If the test runner's honest output embeds run-varying tokens (timings, headers), write a normalizer script (stdin: raw output, stdout: canonical form, exit 0) inside the sandbox and record its absolute path as output_normalizer_prefix/output_normalizer_postfix; digests are then compared through it. Do not record one otherwise.

states.name: VARIANTS_MATERIALIZED
states.instruction: Materialise both declared variants (prefix, postfix) under one directory and record it as variants_root. For each variant write BOTH <variants_root>/setup_<name>.sh -- taking the target directory as its only argument and setting that variant up there from scratch -- and <variants_root>/<name>/, your own materialised copy. The harness re-runs each setup script into a fresh directory and runs that variant's check there.

states.name: DELIVERED

discriminates.describe: test passes on postfix but fails on prefix

states.enforces: Project must be a Python project and must not be one of the 12 excluded repositories: astropy/astropy, django/django, matplotlib/matplotlib, mwaskom/seaborn, pallets/flask, psf/requests, pydata/xarray, pylint-dev/pylint, pytest-dev/pytest, scikit-learn/scikit-learn, sphinx-doc/sphinx, sympy/sympy.
states.instruction: Verify that the repository is a Python project and not in the exclusion list. Confirm that all required fields are present and that the discriminates block shows the test fails on prefix and passes on postfix. This is the final state.
